timing: Locked after the first v2 process failed on its first source update, before any completed source epoch, target metric, target future rollout, target future observation, or target outcome access.

discarded_process.failure: The released trainer invoked auxiliary.backward and simulator backward separately after one DDP forward, causing the DDP reducer to encounter an undefined gradient.

repair.behavior: Compute the teacher-proximity gradient only with respect to the applied intermediate output, attach it as a hook, detach the scalar auxiliary loss, and let the existing simulator backward perform one combined parameter backward and one DDP reduction.
repair.objective_equivalence: The applied gradient is the sum of the simulator gradient and the unchanged teacher-proximity gradient. No loss weight, model input, source outcome, or target boundary changes.

regression_test.assertion: A unit auxiliary gradient of 2 and primary gradient of 3 produce one combined parameter gradient of 5.

unchanged: learning rate, teacher-proximity weight, and gradient clip
